scope: pinned Linux x86_64 KDE runtime, not Windows/macOS or arbitrary Python build use

findings.assessment: Windows path semantics absent from supported Linux runtime; CyrNava does not invoke Mako template lookup. No supported application attack path established.
Application does not produce Python sdists; Linux Flatpak packaging uses exact prebuilt hash-locked wheels, not runtime sdist generation. No supported application attack path established.

findings.affected_path: Windows legacy Wheel.install_as_egg namespace metadata handling
findings.assessment: Supported runtime is Linux and application never invokes legacy wheel installation. Host Flatpak runtime retrieval does not use setuptools installation APIs.

limitations: Direct application import/source scan is not proof about every third-party caller
No runtime patch or upstream lock substitution performed
Reassess if supported platform, build mechanism or package use changes
Not a complete vulnerability-clearance or formal VEX certification
